title: Skeleton Rigging Joint Hierarchy Viewer with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements an interactive skeleton rigging joint hierarchy viewer with full undo/redo support.

## Scene Setup
- Dark background (#1a1a2e). Perspective camera at position (0, 2, 8), looking at origin.
- Ambient light (intensity 0.3) and a directional light from (5, 10, 5) with intensity 0.8.
- Add OrbitControls for camera manipulation.
- Draw a subtle grid helper (size 10, divisions 10, color #333355) on the ground plane.

## Skeleton Hierarchy
- Build a humanoid skeleton hierarchy using Three.js Bone objects with the following joint tree:
  - Root (hip) at (0, 1, 0)
    - Spine at relative (0, 0.5, 0)
      - Chest at relative (0, 0.5, 0)
        - Head at relative (0, 0.6, 0)
        - LeftShoulder at relative (-0.3, 0.4, 0)
          - LeftElbow at relative (-0.5, 0, 0)
            - LeftHand at relative (-0.4, 0, 0)
        - RightShoulder at relative (0.3, 0.4, 0)
          - RightElbow at relative (0.5, 0, 0)
            - RightHand at relative (0.4, 0, 0)
    - LeftHip at relative (-0.2, -0.1, 0)
      - LeftKnee at relative (0, -0.6, 0)
        - LeftFoot at relative (0, -0.6, 0)
    - RightHip at relative (0.2, -0.1, 0)
      - RightKnee at relative (0, -0.6, 0)
        - RightFoot at relative (0, -0.6, 0)
- Create a SkeletonHelper to visualize bones as lines.
- Render each joint as a small sphere (radius 0.06) colored by depth: depth 0 = #ff4444, depth 1 = #ff8844, depth 2 = #ffcc44, depth 3 = #44ff44, depth 4 = #4488ff.

## Joint Selection & Manipulation
- Clicking on a joint sphere selects it. Selected joint glows with emissive color #ffffff and scales to 1.5x.
- Only one joint can be selected at a time. Clicking empty space deselects.
- Display the selected joint name in a HUD panel (top-left, id='joint-info').
- When a joint is selected, show its local rotation (Euler degrees) in a panel (id='rotation-panel') with three sliders (id='slider-x', 'slider-y', 'slider-z') ranging -180 to 180.
- Dragging a slider rotates the selected joint around that local axis in real-time. All child bones must follow (hierarchical transform propagation).
- Keyboard shortcuts: 'X' rotates selected joint +15 degrees around local X. 'Y' rotates +15 degrees around local Y. 'Z' rotates +15 degrees around local Z. Shift+X/Y/Z rotates -15 degrees.

## Undo/Redo System
- Maintain an undo stack and redo stack. Each entry stores: joint name, previous rotation (Euler), new rotation (Euler).
- Ctrl+Z triggers undo. Ctrl+Shift+Z (or Ctrl+Y) triggers redo.
- DOM buttons: id='btn-undo' and id='btn-redo' also trigger undo/redo.
- Display undo stack depth in element id='undo-depth' and redo stack depth in id='redo-depth'.
- Maximum undo history: 50 entries. New actions clear the redo stack.

## Pose Presets
- Add three buttons: id='pose-tpose' (T-Pose, all rotations zero), id='pose-wave' (RightShoulder Z=-90deg, RightElbow Z=-45deg), id='pose-walk' (LeftHip X=-30deg, RightHip X=30deg, LeftShoulder X=20deg, RightShoulder X=-20deg).
- Applying a preset pushes one undo entry per changed joint.

## Animation Playback
- Button id='btn-play' toggles animation playback. When playing, interpolate between T-Pose and Walk pose using a sine wave (period 2 seconds). During playback, selection and manual rotation are disabled.
- Button id='btn-stop' stops playback and returns to the pose before playback started.
- Display playback state in element id='playback-status' ('playing' or 'stopped').

## State Management (window.__3D_STATE__)
Expose the following on window.__3D_STATE__ and update every frame:
- selectedJoint: string|null — name of selected joint
- jointCount: number — total joints in skeleton
- jointNames: string[] — all joint names
- undoDepth: number — current undo stack size
- redoDepth: number — current redo stack size
- playbackStatus: 'playing'|'stopped'
- jointRotations: object — map of joint name to {x, y, z} in degrees (local Euler)
- jointWorldPositions: object — map of joint name to {x, y, z} world positions
- selectedJointScale: number — scale of selected joint sphere (1.0 or 1.5)
- hierarchyDepth: object — map of joint name to depth (integer)
- lastAction: string — 'rotate'|'undo'|'redo'|'preset'|'select'|'deselect'|'play'|'stop'|null
- frameCount: number — incremented each animation frame
- childCountOf: function(jointName) => number — returns number of direct children
- totalDescendantsOf: function(jointName) => number — returns total descendants count
physics_constraints: Hierarchical transform propagation: rotating a parent joint must move all descendant joints accordingly. World positions of child joints must be deterministic functions of the ancestor chain rotations. Undo must restore exact previous rotation values (epsilon < 0.01 degrees). Conservation: total joint count must remain 15 at all times. Bone lengths (distances between parent-child joints) must remain constant regardless of rotations (tolerance < 0.001 units).
